chain.description: Filter to resources supporting this chain.

creator.description: Filter by who built it (prefix match on creator name), e.g. 'Coinbase', 'Privy'.

deploys_as.description: Filter by deployment shape: npm, pip, docker, mcp server, hosted, self-hosted, cli, sdk, claude code plugin.

entity_class.description: Filter by class: 'resource' = things you build/deploy WITH (frameworks, tools, infra, venues, standards); 'agent' = curated, live onchain agents; 'reference' = editorial.

iface.description: Filter by how it is accessed/integrated. One of: mcp, sdk, rest-api, plugin, cli, ui, contract.

integration.description: Filter to resources that integrate with a client or framework, e.g. 'claude code', 'cursor', 'langchain', 'openclaw'. Case-insensitive exact match.

is_agent.description: True = only resources that are themselves onchain agents.

is_harness.description: True = only agent frameworks/harnesses (OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code…).

liveness.description: Filter by activity recency: Active (≤30d), Recent (≤90d), Quiet (≤1y), Dormant (>1y).

mcp_answering.description: True = only listings whose MCP ENDPOINT answered Sato Hub's most recent MCP handshake (one check of ours, not uptime). Use this for 'which MCP servers answer'; min_observed_success alone is mostly a check of a listing's website.

min_observed_days.description: Minimum days of daily observation behind the success rate (default 14 when min_observed_success is set).

min_observed_success.description: Only listings whose share of Sato Hub's daily checks that succeeded is at least this percent, over at least min_observed_days (default 14). This is the share of OUR checks, not uptime.

query.description: Free-text search across name, description, tags, chains, and agent type. Space-separated terms are AND-matched.

resource_type.description: Filter resources by role. Venue = DEX/launchpad/marketplace; Network = an L1/L2.

sort.description: Sort order: priority (default), newest_release, stars, or name.

standard.description: Filter to resources implementing a standard. One of: x402, erc-8004, erc-8183, mcp, a2a.

use_case.description: Filter by use case. One of: trading, payments, wallets, data, identity, privacy, launch, security, build.

verified_only.description: True = only listings whose documented install was reproduced in a container by Sato Hub (deploy_status verified). Says nothing about runtime safety.

name: onchain_agent_search_resources
title: Find crypto-agent tooling by name, chain, standard or what it does
